name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: balik je sestaveny z aktualni WDUi knihovny/headeru se skin schema 2026070501, nacita cely material-gallery runtime skin pack a build-info smoke hlida 50 runtime skin presetu misto ticheho fallbacku. ZIP porad neobsahuje knihovni .cpp zdroje.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: the package is built from the current WDUi library/header with skin schema 2026070501, loads the full material-gallery runtime skin pack, and the build-info smoke now guards 50 runtime skin presets instead of silently falling back. The ZIP still excludes library .cpp sources.
